page.layout: One page of text: a title heading across the top in large capitals with a subtitle line, then a numbered list of authors in roman numerals running down the page with their works. A stamp in the lower middle is not printed text. Running head at top is a faint mirrored show-through and is left out. No page number, no catchword, no signature visible.

main_text.head: AVTHORES, QVO-RVM OPERA VSVS EST huius Opusculi author.
main_text.l: I. Marcus Tullius Cicero libr.3. ad Herennium.
II. Iordanus Brunus Nolanus de Architectura Lulliana & compositione imaginum.
IV. Petrus Gregorius Tholozanus. libr. Syntaxeon artis mirabilis.
V. Valerius de Valeriis. lib. qui inscribitur opus aureum.
VI. Iason Nores. libri Rhetorici Italicè conscripti, qui Legatis, Ecclesiasticis, Iudicibus, Oratoribus perutiles sunt.
VII. Antonius Posseuinus. libr. 18. Bibliotheca selecta.
VIII. Raymundus Lullius: ars eius brevis, Kabbala, Rhetorica, ars magna, generalis & ultima, via veritatis, ars demonstrativa.
IX. Petrus Rauennas, qui dicitur, magister de memoria.
XI. Iohannes Romberch de Kirspe monachus.

page.notes: Library stamp in the lower middle (BAYERISCHE STAATS BIBLIOTHEK MUENCHEN) omitted. Faint mirrored show-through at the top omitted. Some words in the list are partly faded; "Dusiluius" and "Rauennas" are read as printed but uncertain. Roman numerals in the list are reproduced as printed, with the names following.
